findings.description: Genus iff, duplicate applicability/boundary voices, opaque printed predicate and nonentailment notation require source-owner precedence review.
Closed/versioned/Policy-bound specification and nine defined dimensions need accepted field, grammar, population and immutable version maps; raw completeness is not qualification.
Mechanism, route, record, Policy, event, subject and same-field mechanisms retain separate identities; no fabricated global sort separation.
Filing does not entail actual suspension/reversal; automatic causal effect prohibition is not blanket no-effect. Real filing/right/standing/decision/time semantics unaccepted.
Subject/challenger kinds, grounds, evidence and response modes require exact version/currentness, population and authentication maps.
Owner route, resolution gate, response period, unresolved residue, promotion blocking and lifecycle need universal temporal/operational semantics.

Current dedicated carrier and admitted foundation overlays are exact evidence, not whole semantic alignment. Empty arrays, version fields, embedded role direction pairs and Policy resolution need review.
Thirty-four authored uses and selected evidence do not establish reviewed edge completeness, common carrier alignment or source-owner fidelity.
